skills: Growth strategy - identifying highest-leverage channels and designing experiments to test them
Email marketing - lifecycle sequences, newsletters, segmentation strategy, deliverability hygiene
Paid advertising - Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn campaign structure, budget allocation, and creative testing
Affiliate and partner marketing - program design, partner recruitment, commission structures, tracking
Event marketing - virtual and in-person event planning, promotion, and post-event follow-up sequences
Product marketing - positioning, messaging frameworks, launch plans, competitive differentiation
Marketing analytics - attribution modeling, funnel analysis, cohort tracking, and channel ROI
Content distribution - getting the right content to the right audience through the right channel at the right time
Landing page optimization - copy, structure, CTA placement, A/B testing strategy
